Name: Fix Android 14 photo upload crash
Description: Marcus to fix the photo upload crash on Android 14 caused by NullPointerException in the media picker callback when the app is backgrounded mid-upload. Fix must be completed and verified by Wednesday to allow QA testing before the mobile release on August 20. Sam will confirm the fix on Android 14 test devices and include it in the regression test run.

Name: Implement offline mode for notes list
Description: Elena to build the backend sync API endpoint for offline mode that returns a delta of created, updated, and deleted notes based on last-synced timestamp, using last-write-wins conflict resolution. Marcus will implement the client-side local cache in Room, queue writes offline, and replay them when online. Acceptance criteria: users can open the app in airplane mode, view and edit notes, and have all changes reconcile without data loss when online. The acceptance criteria must be documented in the ticket.

Name: Migrate CI pipelines to GitHub Actions
Description: Sam to complete migration of test and release pipelines to GitHub Actions this sprint, maintaining the nightly build schedule. Both Jenkins and GitHub Actions will run in parallel for one week. Jenkins will be turned off only after the parallel run is stable. Priya approved this plan and requests Jenkins remain alive until the parallel week is clean.

Name: Add per-user rate limiting to search endpoint
Description: Elena to add per-user rate limiting to the search endpoint to limit users to 100 requests per minute. Requests exceeding the limit must return HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header. Additionally, Elena will implement a metrics counter to monitor users hitting the limit. This is to prevent service degradation caused by misbehaving scripts.

Name: Update privacy policy consent screen for GDPR compliance
Description: Marcus to update the privacy policy consent screen for the EU launch to meet GDPR requirements. The consent must be opt-in with separate toggles for analytics and marketing, with no single pre-checked box. Marcus will get the new copy from legal and rebuild the screen accordingly. This update is a launch blocker and must be included in the August 20 mobile release.

Name: Write automated regression tests for payments flow
Description: Sam to write automated regression tests covering purchase, restore, cancellation, and receipt validation paths in the payments flow. The tests should be integrated into the CI pipeline running on GitHub Actions. This is to prevent issues like those encountered in the last release and improve test coverage.
